title: Xtra Power Circular Saw Blade, 4 inch, 40T, TCT, Wood Cutting Blade
description: Xtra Power Circular Saw Blade, 4 inch, 40T, TCT, Wood Cutting Blade - Distributed/Packaged by Akron. Product Details: Elevate your woodworking precision with this premium 4-inch TCT circular saw blade from Xtra Power. Featuring 40 razor-sharp tungsten carbide-tipped teeth, this blade delivers exceptional cutting performance and durability. The 110mm diameter blade is specifically engineered for wood cutting applications, offering extreme speed and precision with every cut. Its professional-grade construction ensures clean, splinter-free cuts while maintaining optimal cutting efficiency. The blade's robust design and high-quality materials make it ideal for both professional contractors and DIY enthusiasts. Perfect for various woodworking tasks, from cross-cutting to ripping through different types of wood. The blade's balanced design reduces vibration for smoother operation and enhanced safety. Compatible with standard 4-inch circular saws, this blade represents the perfect blend of performance and reliability for your woodworking needs.
